headline: Review of grants acceptance, subcommittee reports, and first reading of a policy on interacting with law enforcement officers engaged in civil law enforcement.
summary: The committee will hear subcommittee reports, review a Superintendent's Report, and vote on accepting several grants. It will also hold a first reading of Policy ACL on interacting with law enforcement officers engaged in civil law enforcement.
items: Oral Communications
Comments from the Chairperson
Recognitions
GHS Student Advisory Council update
Approval of Warrants
Approval of Transfers
Acceptance of Donations
Acceptance of Gifts
Superintendent's Report
Partner Presentation: GEF Annual Presentation by Emily Siegel
Professional Development Plan Update
Program Subcommittee report on Policy ACL - Interacting with Law Enforcement Officers Engaged in Civil Law Enforcement (Protect Act)

Building and Finance Subcommittee report on DPW tickets, FY25 end of year audit, special education out-of-district tuition and transportation, staffing update, budget transfers, content planning, and GHS library technical issues
First Reading of Policy ACL - Interacting with Law Enforcement Officers Engaged in Civil Law Enforcement (Protect Act)
Acceptance of GEF O'Maley Academy Grant of $30,000
Acceptance of GEF Grade 4-8 Band Grant of $30,000
Acceptance of GEF Medical Assisting Staffing Grant of $64,000
Acceptance of GEF K-8 STEM Coordinator Grant of $100,000
Acceptance of GEF Science Central Wilson Intern Grant of $5,000
Acceptance of GEF GHS Engineering Lab Grant of $50,000
Acceptance of GEF Gender Equity in STEM Club Grant of $14,000
